extracted.intended_audience: patent practitioners and attorneys seeking reinstatement to practice before the USPTO; regulators and counsel involved in enrollment and discipline
extracted.subtask_description: Administrative decision on a petition to reinstate an attorney to practice before the USPTO under 37 C.F.R. § 11.58; the office considers the petition, supporting affidavit, any supplemental actions taken by the petitioner, and all record information material to eligibility for reinstatement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petition for Reinstatement
rubrics_metrics.description: Consideration has been given to the Petition for Reinstatement ... received on [date].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A formal petition must be filed and received by the Office of Enrollment and Discipline to initiate consideration for reinstatement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Affidavit pursuant to 37 C.F.R. § 11.58
rubrics_metrics.description: Mr. Jensen has filed an Affidavit pursuant to 37 C.F.R. § 11.58 in support of the Petition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The petition should be supported by an affidavit complying with 37 C.F.R. § 11.58; the affidavit is a required evidentiary component for reinstatement petitions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supplemental actions following filing
rubrics_metrics.description: After careful review of the Petition, the supporting affidavit, Mr. Jensen’s supplemental actions following the filing of his petition ...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Actions taken by the petitioner after filing (e.g., remediation, compliance steps, documentation) are considered along with the petition and affidavit and may affect the outcome.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consideration of all record information material to eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: After careful review of ... all information in the record material to his eligibility for reinstatement, the Director ... has determined ... reinstatement ... is appropriate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Office reviews the entire administrative record for information material to eligibility; the completeness and substance of record evidence bear on the decision.

rubrics_metrics.name: Director's determination of appropriateness
rubrics_metrics.description: The Director of the Office of Enrollment and Discipline has determined that reinstatement ... is appropriate. Accordingly, the Petition is hereby GRANTED.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Director (Deputy General Counsel for Enrollment and Discipline) has discretion to grant or deny reinstatement based on the petition, affidavit, supplemental actions, and record; the decision is issued as an administrative order.
